Alias.name: delete old profiles
Alias.script:
deleteOldProfiles(matches[3], matches[2])
--Syntax examples: "delete old profiles" -> deletes profiles older than 31 days -- "delete old maps 10" -> deletes maps older than 10 days

Script.name: deleteOldProfiles script
Script.script:
function deleteOldProfiles(keepdays_arg, delete_folder) --[[ Deletes old profiles/maps/modules in the "current"/"map"/"moduleBackups" folders of the Mudlet home directory. The following files are NOT deleted: - Files newer than the amount of days specified as an argument to deleteOldProfiles(), or 31 days if not specified. - One file for every month before that. Specifically: The first save of every month prior to this; a leftover from an interrupted save does not count. For module backups, every module keeps its own. - The newest profile save (.xml) or map (.dat/.json), which is the one Mudlet loads, however old it is. Module backups are never loaded, so there it is the newest backup of every module. - A leftover from an interrupted save, when there is no save Mudlet would load. - Folders, which are left alone. The second argument picks the folder: "profiles", "maps" or "modules". (e.g. deleteOldProfiles(10, "maps")) --]]
-- Ensure correct value is passed for second argument assert(type(delete_folder) == "string", "Wrong type for delete_folder; expected string, got " .. type(delete_folder)) assert(table.contains({"profiles", "maps", "modules"}, delete_folder), "delete_folder must be profiles, maps or modules")
local keepdays = tonumber(keepdays_arg) or 31 local profile_table = {} local used_last_mod_months = {} local slash = (string.char(getMudletHomeDir():byte()) == "/") and "/" or "\\" local delnum = 0
local to_folder = { profiles = "current", maps = "map", }
local dirpath = delete_folder == "modules" and getMudletHomeDir()..slash..".."..slash..".."..slash.."moduleBackups" or getMudletHomeDir()..slash..to_folder[delete_folder]
-- these folders are created lazily, with the first file saved into one, and -- lfs.dir() raises rather than listing nothing when the folder is not there if lfs.attributes(dirpath, "mode") ~= "directory" then echo(string.format("\nNo %s have been backed up yet, nothing to delete.", delete_folder)) return end
-- Traverse the profiles folder and create a table of files: for filename in lfs.dir(dirpath) do local attributes = lfs.attributes(dirpath..slash..filename) -- folders are not backups; attributes can be nil if a save renames the file meanwhile if attributes and attributes.mode == "file" then profile_table[#profile_table+1] = { name = filename, last_mod = attributes.modification, -- every module's backups share one folder, so each module is kept as a series of its own series = delete_folder == "modules" and (filename:match("^(.-)%d%d%d%d%-%d%d%-%d%d#%d%d%-%d%d%-%d%d$") or filename) or "" } end end
-- Sort the table according to last modification date from old to new: table.sort(profile_table, function (a,b) return a.last_mod < b.last_mod end)
echo(string.format( "\nDeleting old %s. Files newer than %d days, one for every month before that and the newest one will be kept.", delete_folder, keepdays ))
-- An interrupted save can leave a temporary file behind, which is not a save and does -- not take a month's spot. Mudlet loads the newest .xml profile or .dat/.json map; times -- are whole seconds, so it may load any save tied for newest and every one stays. -- XML maps load only from Map history, never on startup. Module backups are never -- loaded, so every file there counts as a save. local savedExtensions = {profiles = {xml = true}, maps = {dat = true, json = true, xml = true}} local loadedExtensions = {profiles = {xml = true}, maps = {dat = true, json = true}} local function hasExtension(name, extensions) if not extensions[delete_folder] then return true end local extension = name:match("%.([^.]+)$") return extension ~= nil and extensions[delete_folder][extension:lower()] == true end local newestLoadedTime = {} for _, v in ipairs(profile_table) do if hasExtension(v.name, loadedExtensions) then newestLoadedTime[v.series] = v.last_mod end end
for _, v in ipairs(profile_table) do local days = math.floor(os.difftime(os.time(), v.last_mod) / 86400) local last_mod_month = v.series .. "|" .. os.date("%Y/%m", v.last_mod) if days > keepdays then -- For saves older than X days, check if we already kept one for this month: local saved = hasExtension(v.name, savedExtensions) if saved and not table.contains(used_last_mod_months, last_mod_month) then -- If not, do nothing and mark this month as "kept". used_last_mod_months[#used_last_mod_months+1] = last_mod_month elseif v.last_mod == newestLoadedTime[v.series] and hasExtension(v.name, loadedExtensions) then -- Keep every file tied for the newest; for profiles and maps that is what Mudlet loads. elseif not saved and not newestLoadedTime[v.series] then -- With no save Mudlet would load, a leftover may be all that is left to recover by hand. else local success, errorstring = os.remove(dirpath..slash..v.name) if success then delnum = delnum + 1 else cecho("\n<red>ERROR: "..errorstring) end end end end
echo(string.format("\nDeletion complete. %d/%d files were removed successfully.", delnum, #profile_table)) end
